title: How Developer Personality Shapes the Use of AI Coding Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2611.21240v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Developers differ in personality traits that shape how they approach software development tasks, yet AI coding assistants either behave uniformly or offer personalization features whose fit with individual developers must be found through trial and error. This is because it remains unclear how personality shapes developers' experiences with AI assistants, and thus which traits personalization should account for. In other words, we provide tools with no underlying theory on what works when and why. We take a first step towards such a theory with a systematic scoping review on how users' personality relates to their perception of LLM-based tools. We identified twelve studies through general search engines, major Software Engineering (SE) venues, AI tooling, and snowballing. They all reported associations between personality and perceptions, particularly perceived usefulness, yet none addressed this in a SE context.   Building on these find

translated_title: 开发者人格如何塑造AI编程助手的使用
translated_abstract: 开发者在人格特质上各不相同，这些特质影响着他们处理软件开发任务的方式；然而，AI编程助手要么行为千篇一律，要么虽提供个性化功能，却需要开发者通过反复试错才能找到与自己契合的设置。这是因为人格如何塑造开发者与AI助手的交互体验尚不清楚，因而个性化功能应当考虑哪些特质也无从得知。换言之，我们在缺乏“什么在何时有效、为何有效”这一底层理论的情况下为开发者提供了工具。为迈出构建此类理论的第一步，本文开展了一项系统性范围综述，研究用户人格与其对基于大语言模型（LLM）工具的感知之间的关系。我们通过通用搜索引擎、主流软件工程（SE）学术会议、AI工具检索以及滚雪球引用追踪等方法，共识别出十二项研究。这些研究均报告了人格与用户感知之间的关联，尤其是对感知有用性的影响，但尚无研究在软件工程（SE）情境下对此进行探讨。基于这些发现……
tldr: 本文通过系统性范围综述首次梳理了用户人格与基于LLM工具感知（尤其是感知有用性）之间的关联，指出软件工程领域尚缺相关研究，为面向开发者人格的AI编程助手个性化理论迈出第一步。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a systematic scoping review of twelve studies linking users' personality to their perceptions of LLM-based tools (especially perceived usefulness), highlighting the lack of SE-context research and taking a first step toward a theory for personalizing AI coding assistants to developer personality.
